tests.description: Unmodified snapshot of the five existing DW-39 SDK parser-to-mapper error cases referenced by the corrected DW-77 header.

cases.name: a null message produces a contextual database fallback
Unicode whitespace uses the fallback and retains null diagnostics
CHECK mapping takes precedence over an empty SDK message
meaningful message whitespace survives SDK parsing and conversion
a numeric SDK message retains compatibility without throwing

tests.scope_note: The documentation-only bundle changes no API behavior. Existing complete cases are reused without copying them into the canonical runner directory.

fixture_details.purpose: Canonical Playwright fixture composition and expect export; reuse its existing auth disable option.
Complete controlled malformed-error envelope with narrow overrides; message stays present for the production classifier.
Per-invocation SDK client and injected fetch, included intact in snapshot; no server, row, account or cleanup ownership.

playwright_utils_deviations.reason: SDK fetch injection exercises its parser; apiRequest bypasses that boundary.
playwright_utils_deviations.scope: Controlled in-memory SDK transport; no live application HTTP request uses a vanilla request API.

schema_validation: No response schema covers malformed errors; assertions cover the fields under test. This existing limitation is documented in the preserved source header.
authentication: authSessionEnabled:false; wholly injected transport. Existing auth wiring remains unchanged.
pact_note: Pact broker: unreachable (SmartBear MCP tools not available). Provider states derived from provider source. Parent probe result reused without another probe; no Pact artifacts required for a documentation-only bundle.
summary: Prepared an unmodified snapshot of 5 existing API cases (2 P1, 3 P2), preserving original IDs and assertions. Added no tests of comments and no runtime code. Existing SDK parser injection deviation and fixture dependencies are recorded; parent owns artifact placement and execution.
